headline: Same SSRF in the connection test endpoint, reached through a redirect chain as well as directly.
analysis: Both reports land in the same unvalidated outbound request from /api/v1/connections/test; the redirect chain is a second path to the same flaw, closed by the same allowlist fix.
merged_summary: SSRF via the connection test endpoint lets authenticated users reach internal hosts and cloud metadata endpoints, directly or by following redirects.
